parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and pump out the liquid from the dispenser. It acts as the actuator of the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head part connects the pressing lid to the base body and contains the pump mechanism. It is made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal pump components and provides a channel for the liquid to flow from the bottle to the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but allows internal movement of the pump components during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or semi-transparent PET plastic. It holds the liquid content.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (such as soap, lotion, or sanitizer) and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
